```artifact
// GUI Event Graphs for unit U16_GUI

// Graph 1: Adjust PEEP (RW-SW-162)
Start -> PEEP_Slider[0-20 cmH2O, step=1] -> Confirm_PEEP[required] -> Display_PEEP[0-20 cmH2O] -> End

// Graph 2: Adjust RR (RW-SW-12)
Start -> RR_Slider[5-30 bpm, step=1] -> Confirm_RR[required] -> Display_RR[5-30 bpm] -> End

// Graph 3: Adjust IER (RW-SW-13)
Start -> IER_Slider[1:1 to 1:4] -> Confirm_IER[required] -> Display_IER[1:1 to 1:4] -> End

// Graph 4: Confirm all ventilation and alarm setting changes (RW-SW-24)
Start -> Change_Ventilation_Alarm -> Confirm_Change[required] -> Display_Changed_Settings -> End

// Graph 5: Adjust FiO2 (RW-SW-34)
Start -> FiO2_Slider[0.21-0.96 to 1.0, step=0.1] -> Confirm_FiO2[required] -> Display_FiO2[0.21-1.0] -> End

// Graph 6: Adjust HFNC flow rate (RW-SW-35)
Start -> HFNC_Flow_Slider[0-60 L/min, step=5] -> Confirm_HFNC[required] -> Display_HFNC_Flow[0-60 L/min] -> End

// Graph 7: Compute leakage (RW-SW-43)
Start -> Input_Controller_Actuation -> Input_Sensor_Readings -> Compute_Leakage -> Display_Leakage -> End
```
